title: TikTok Monetization Strategy
summary: TikTok monetizes through four main revenue streams: in-feed and top view ads, TikTok Shop commissions, brand partnerships, and virtual gifts to creators. The platform's strengths include algorithm superiority, a highly engaged Gen Z user base, and seamless TikTok Shop integration. Ad formats are categorized by funnel stage, with metrics varying from Impressions for awareness to ROAS for conversion.

key_points.text: TikTok has four main revenue streams: advertising, TikTok Shop, brand partnerships, and virtual gifts
Advertising primarily through in-feed ads (every 2 to 3 videos) and TopView ads (when users first open the app)
TikTok Shop monetizes by taking a commission on every transaction, typically 2-8% depending on category, and charging sellers to advertise products
Brand partnerships include hashtag challenges where brands pay $150K-500K+, brand takeover days, and large-scale brand awareness campaigns
Algorithm superiority keeps users engaged longer and makes ads feel native to the app
TikTok is Gen Z dominant, spending around 95 mins on the app every day, driving high engagement rates
Top of funnel metrics include Impressions, Reach, Frequency, and Brand Awareness Lift
Middle of funnel metrics include Click-Through Rate, Time on Site, Email signups, and Add-to-Cart actions
